name: 189. Bedrock chat prompt cache control preserved alongside guardrail tagging (#8215 / PR #8216) (bedrock-prompt-cache-guardrail)
description: Pins that prompt cache control markers (cache_control) survive deep copying on the Bedrock Claude InvokeModel path during guardrail tagging, and map to Converse cachePoint blocks on the Converse path (#8215 / PR #8216).

item.name: Bedrock chat completions InvokeModel: cache_control survives guardrail deep copy (Sonnet 4.6) - #8215

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
// #8215: when guardrailConfig / guard_content is supplied on a Bedrock Claude InvokeModel chat request (e.g. carrying compaction),
// the request is deep-copied in invokeChatGuardTagging for tag synthesis. Before the fix, deepCopyChatContentBlock dropped
// cache_control, citations, and breakpoint fields. The raw request capture proves cache_control survives to the Anthropic payload.
pm.test('Bedrock chat completions InvokeModel cache_control alongside guardrail - #8215: request succeeds', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('Bedrock chat completions InvokeModel cache_control alongside guardrail - #8215: raw request egresses via InvokeModel', function () {
var raw = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { raw = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { raw = null; } }
pm.expect(raw, 'raw request capture missing: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(raw.anthropic_version, 'anthropic_version missing: request did not route to InvokeModel').to.eql('bedrock-2023-05-31');
pm.test('Bedrock chat completions InvokeModel cache_control alongside guardrail - #8215: prompt cache_control preserved in raw request', function () {
var raw = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { raw = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { raw = null; } }
pm.expect(raw, 'raw request capture missing: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
var blocks = ((raw.messages || [])[0] || {}).content || [];
pm.expect(blocks.length, 'expected at least 2 content blocks: ' + JSON.stringify(blocks)).to.be.at.least(2);
var cached = blocks.filter(function (b) { return b && b.cache_control && b.cache_control.type === 'ephemeral'; });
pm.expect(cached.length, 'cache_control was stripped by deep copy during guardrail tagging: ' + JSON.stringify(blocks)).to.eql(1);
var guarded = blocks.filter(function (b) { return b && typeof b.text === 'string' && b.text.indexOf('amazon-bedrock-guardrails-query_h7q2') !== -1; });
pm.expect(guarded.length, 'guardrail tag missing on guarded block: ' + JSON.stringify(blocks)).to.eql(1);

item.name: Bedrock chat completions Converse: cache_control converts to cachePoint block (Haiku 4.5) - #8215

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
// On the standard Bedrock Converse chat completions path, cache_control converts to a separate { cachePoint: { type: "default" } } block.
pm.test('Bedrock chat completions Converse cachePoint alongside guardrail - #8215: request succeeds', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('Bedrock chat completions Converse cachePoint alongside guardrail - #8215: cachePoint block present in raw request', function () {
var raw = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { raw = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { raw = null; } }
pm.expect(raw, 'raw request capture missing: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
var blocks = ((raw.messages || [])[0] || {}).content || [];
var cachePoints = blocks.filter(function (b) { return b && b.cachePoint && b.cachePoint.type === 'default'; });
pm.expect(cachePoints.length, 'expected exactly one cachePoint block in Converse request: ' + JSON.stringify(blocks)).to.eql(1);
var guarded = blocks.filter(function (b) { return b && b.guardContent && b.guardContent.text && b.guardContent.text.text === 'What is the capital of France?'; });
pm.expect(guarded.length, 'guardContent entry missing in Converse request: ' + JSON.stringify(blocks)).to.eql(1);
pm.expect(guarded[0].guardContent.text.qualifiers, 'qualifiers not forwarded').to.eql(['query']);
